curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 胆道高凶险实体瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 胆道系统最常见且最凶险的恶性肿瘤之一，胆囊壁缺乏黏膜下层且毗邻肝脏与重要血管，极易早期直接浸润肝脏及淋巴结转移；晚期常并发恶性梗阻性黄疸、急性化脓性胆囊炎穿孔或肝功能衰竭，未治中位生存仅3–6个月。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 早期（T1a期）单纯胆囊切除或（T1b–T2期）扩大根治术可获得较高治愈率（Ⅰ期5年生存率约60%–80%）；但因早期症状与胆囊结石/胆囊炎高度重叠，超过70%确诊为中晚期，整体5年生存率仅约15%–20%，晚期主要依靠化疗联合免疫及HER2等靶向延缓进展。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: 2022年全球约9.20万例死亡，死亡发病比高达0.73，高发于智利、印度北部及东亚部分地区

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 2022年中国约2.57万例死亡，占全球胆囊癌死亡总数的约27.9%，女性发病略高于男性且与胆囊结石高度相关

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 2022年全球新发约126,384例，约80%–90%合并胆囊结石（GLOBOCAN 2022）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 2022年中国新发约33,523例（占全球约26.5%），中老年女性及长期胆囊结石/胆囊息肉(>1cm)/瓷化胆囊人群为高危群体

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 肿瘤坏死或合并急性化脓性胆囊炎导致胆囊穿孔/胆汁性腹膜炎：立即禁食胃肠减压、静脉抗感染补液并急诊外科手术引流或介入经皮胆囊穿刺引流(PTGBD); 2) 肿瘤压迫肝总管致急性梗阻性黄疸伴胆管炎：急诊行PTCD或ERCP引流减黄。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 高危癌前病变预防性切除（直径≥1cm单发胆囊息肉、瓷化胆囊、合并胆囊结石>3cm或胰胆管合流异常）
意外胆囊癌(术后病理发现≥T1b期)尽早行二次根治性扩大肝楔形切除+区域淋巴结清扫
常规检测HER2表达/扩增、MSI-H/dMMR及NGS靶点
术后定期复查肝胆超声/增强CT及CA19-9/CEA
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 根治性扩大手术及术后卡培他滨辅助全程约5万–10万元；晚期化疗联合PD-1/PD-L1或HER2-ADC费用减免前年均约10万–25万元

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) TOPAZ-1与KEYNOTE-966确立PD-L1/PD-1联合GC化疗为晚期胆囊癌一线全球标准; 2) 胆囊癌是胆道肿瘤中HER2阳性率最高(约12%–15%)的亚型，Zanidatamab(HER2双抗，HERIZON-BTC-01研究)与T-DXd(DESTINY-PanTumor02)在HER2 IHC 3+人群均取得约40%–56%的客观缓解率; 3) 2024–2026年多项新辅助免疫联合化疗及放疗降期转化研究正探索提高局部进展期胆囊癌R0切除率。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 早期极易被当成‘普通胆囊炎/胆结石’延误，约70%以上患者丧失根治手术机会; 2) 腹腔种植与肝转移复发率极高，缺乏高敏感血液早筛标志物; 3) HER2阴性且免疫原发性耐药患者的二线方案有效率不足10%。

master.definition_en: Aspergillosis is an infection, growth, or allergic response caused by the Aspergillus fungus. There are several different kinds of aspergillosis. One kind is allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis (also called ABPA), a condition where the fungus causes allergic respiratory symptoms similar to asthma, such as wheezing and coughing, but does not actually invade and destroy tissue. Another kind of aspergillosis is invasive aspergillosis. This infection usually affects people with weakened immune systems due to cancer, AIDS, leukemia, organ transplantation, chemotherapy, or other conditions or events that reduce the number of normal white blood cells. In this condition, the fungus invades and damages tissues in the body. Invasive aspergillosis most commonly affects the lungs, but can also cause infection in many other organs and can spread throughout the body (commonly affecting the kidneys and brain). Aspergilloma, a growth (fungus ball) that develops in an area of previous lung disease such as tuberculosis or lung abscess, is a third kind of aspergillosis. This type of aspergillosis is composed of a tangled mass of fungus fibers, blood clots, and white blood cells. The fungus ball gradually enlarges, destroying lung tissue in the process, but usually does not spread to other areas.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 以急性弥漫性肺泡-毛细血管膜损伤、肺顺应性骤降及顽固性低氧血症为特征，数小时至数日内迅速恶化。全球大型ICU研究（LUNG SAFE）中轻、中、重度ARDS住院病死率分别达34.9%、40.3%和46.1%。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前缺乏直接修复肺泡-毛细血管屏障的特效药物，主要依靠小潮气量肺保护性通气、俯卧位通气、ECMO挽救及积极治疗原发病（如肺炎、脓毒症）使部分患者肺功能逐步恢复，但重度患者住院死亡率仍高达40%–56%。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO全球卫生估计（GHE）未单列ARDS死因条目，其死亡通常归因于基础诱因（肺炎、脓毒症、创伤、COVID-19等）。LUNG SAFE研究显示ARDS住院总病死率约34.9%–46.1%。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国性单列死亡登记总量；多中心ICU前瞻性队列显示肺炎约占中国ARDS诱因的77%，总体住院病死率约40%–46%+（轻度约31%、中度约40%、重度约56%）。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球50国LUNG SAFE研究显示，ARDS占全部ICU收治患者的10.4%，占机械通气患者的23%，因识别不足常被低估。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 国内多中心ICU监测中ARDS是机械通气患者最核心的危重呼吸综合征之一，冬季重症肺炎及流感/新冠流行季发病明显攀升。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 立即识别氧合指数（PaO2/FiO2 ≤300 mmHg，依据柏林定义或全球新定义）与双肺渗出影；快速建立高级气道并行肺保护性机械通气（小潮气量6 mL/kg预测体重、平台压≤30 cmH2O、个体化PEEP）；中重度（PaO2/FiO2 <150 mmHg）尽早启动每日≥12–16小时俯卧位通气；保守液体管理（休克纠正后限制液体过负荷）；常规通气难治性低氧血症尽快评估VV-ECMO支持，同时针对原发感染或诱因立即干预。

curated.category: 遗传性心脏离子通道病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 心脏钠通道基因（以SCN5A最常见，约占20%–30%）功能缺失，导致右心室流出道心外膜电位梯度失衡，心电图呈特征性V1–V3导联“穹窿型ST段抬高”; 2) 患者心脏结构通常完全正常，却极易在30–40岁青壮年男性夜间安静睡眠或高热时突发多形性室速与心室颤动，在数分钟内无声猝死（俗称“青壮年夜间猝死”）; 3) 发热是诱发室颤电风暴的最危险扳机。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 有晕厥史、自发I型心电图或心脏骤停幸存的高危患者，植入ICD是预防猝死的金标准；对于反复ICD电击或无法植入ICD者，口服奎尼丁及经导管右心室流出道心外膜射频消融术（可消除异常心电图和室颤基质）疗效卓越；无症状低危患者仅需严格退热及避药管理。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE未单列Brugada综合征死因；估算占全球心脏结构正常青壮年猝死的约20%，在东南亚及东亚男性夜间不明原因猝死综合征（SUNDS）中占比极高

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国单列死亡人数；国内南方地区（如广东、广西等地）临床检出相对集中，男性发病率约为女性的8倍
annual_deaths_china.source: 中华医学会心电生理和起搏分会

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球平均患病率约 1 / 2,000（欧美约1/10,000，东南亚与东亚地区高达1/270–1/1,000，Orphanet ORPHA:130）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国南方及沿海地区人群携带I型/隐匿型心电图特征比例明显高于北方，是青壮年夜间猝死的重要遗传病因

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 患者睡眠中突发喘息呻吟、抽搐叫不醒，立即判断呼吸脉搏并拨打120、行胸外按压及AED除颤; 2) 一旦确诊或高度怀疑Brugada综合征电风暴，院内急救首选静脉持续泵注异丙肾上腺素（提高基础心率、抑制瞬时外向钾电流Ito，能迅速平息室颤风暴），并配合口服奎尼丁; 3) 发热是极度危险诱因，遇体温>38℃必须立即物理降温+安全退热药（对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬），严禁使用胺碘酮或利多卡因（钠通道阻滞可加重Brugada电风暴）。

master.definition_en: A rare primary lymphedema characterized by bilateral, painless lower limb swelling present at birth. Prominent veins around the ankles and on the dorsa of the feet, dysplastic and upslanting toenails due to edema of the nailbed, and subtle dysmorphic facial features (such as high forehead, hypertelorism, depressed nasal bridge, mild bilateral ear dysplasia, and short neck) have also been described. The degree of lymphatic impairment is milder than in the otherwise clinically similar Milroy disease, as evidenced by slightly less severe lymphedema and significantly more uptake of tracers on lymphoscintigraphy.

master.definition_en: A rare hepatic disease characterized by intrahepatic cholestasis and deterioration of liver function in patients receiving parenteral nutrition for extended periods of time (signs may appear as early as within the first two weeks of initiation of parenteral nutrition). The condition commonly occurs in neonates and usually resolves with transition to enteral feeding, although severe cases may progress to liver fibrosis, cirrhosis, and portal hypertension.

master.definition_en: A condition of metabolic abnormalities that result from a spontaneous or therapy-related cytolysis of tumor cells. Tumor lysis syndrome typically occurs in aggressive, rapidly proliferating lymphoproliferative disorders. Burkitt lymphoma and T cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia are commonly associated with this syndrome. Metabolic abnormalities include hyperuricemia, lactic acidosis, hyperkalemia, hyperphosphatemia and hypocalcemia and may result in renal failure, multiple organ failure, and death.

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: An ovarian serous carcinoma characterized by low-grade cytologic features, infrequent mitotic figures and slow tumor growth, which is thought to develop from a serous borderline ovarian tumor. It shows an activated mitogen-activated protein kinase pathway with KRAS and BRAF mutations and only rarely TP53 mutations, and is a distinct entity from high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma rather than a grade of it. It accounts for 2-5% of ovarian carcinomas and 5-10% of serous ovarian carcinomas.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: A rare visceral arteriovenous malformation of the pancreas characterized by abnormal blood flow from the arterial system directly into the venous system without passing through the capillaries. Patients may present with episodic gastrointestinal bleeding or hemoperitoneum, epigastric or abdominal pain, pancreatitis, portal hypertension, and pseudocysts. Some patients remain asymptomatic.

master.definition_en: A substance-related disorder that involves the recurring use of cocaine despite negative consequences. Cocaine use disorder is a diagnosis in DSM-5 that corresponds to two separate diagnoses  in DSM-IV: cocaine abuse and cocaine dependence.
